description:
Today's real deals at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu, Dunnes Stores and Lidl: offers at the lowest price on record for that product at that shop, or the first offer it has ever had. Each is measured against the product's own price history, not the shop's was price, so a recurring or long-running price does not count as a deal.

The biggest saving comes first, against the usual price or the price it typically sold at, whichever is less, so a product that is usually on offer does not lead. By that saving, the shops take turns among deals that save alike, so one shop does not fill the top of the list, and no deal comes ahead of one that saves more than twice as much. Every promotion on sale is judged, so this covers them all, and offset reaches every deal. Covers food, drinks, alcohol, household, baby and pet products unless another aisle is named. Tobacco, infant formula and medicines are never included.

Returns {"as_of", "note", "total", "deals"}. total counts every deal for this search, across all pages, and next_offset is the next page's offset, missing on the last page. Each deal has name, store, pack, you_pay, regular_price, saving_eur, saving_pct, card_needed, buy_quantity, offer_ends, url and category, and the record behind it: kind, lowest_since, low_before, low_before_date, offer_start, run_start, days_on_offer, started_today, cut_today, yesterday_price, back_after_days, typical_price, offer_share and abv. started_today is true only for an offer that began on the collection day; an offer running for weeks whose price fell that day has cut_today instead, and offer_start says since when it has been on offer. One credit per deal returned.

category.description: An aisle or shelf, e.g. "frozen", "household" or "toiletries". "alcohol" is every drink above 0.5% ABV at the five chains, low-alcohol ones included. "alcohol free" is the drinks of 0.5% ABV or less: by the strength on record, by a name that says alcohol free, non-alcoholic, 0.0 or de-alcoholised, or, with no strength on record, by a shelf that says so (a shop's shared "low and no" shelf alone does not count); "low and no" adds the low-alcohol drinks on those shelves. The drinks aisles are "wine", "beer", "cider", "spirits" (liqueurs included), "liqueurs" and "premixes" (alcopops and canned cocktails), or a list such as "beer and cider". Together they hold all of "alcohol" but a drink whose shelf, name, type and strength place it in none of them, such as a beer shelved only under a shop's whole drinks department with only its brand for a name. "drinks" is every drink, alcohol included; "soft drinks" leaves alcohol out.

limit.description: How many deals to return in one page (default 20, at most 200).

offset.description: How many rows to skip, for the next page: the next_offset of the page before (default 0).

query.description: Words in the product's name or brand, e.g. "heinz" or "baileys": a product or a brand, never an aisle (few wines have the word wine in their name).

store.description: One shop to look in only that one: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl. Leave it out for all five.

name: best_deals

left.description: Credits left on the account after it
left.title: Left

note.description: Said when the balance is low, or when it cut this answer short
note.title: Note

used.description: Credits this answer cost: one for each record it returned
used.title: Used

abv.description: Alcohol by volume in percent, as the product's record has it. Empty when none is stated, and when the record cannot be right: over 100, over what a drink of its aisle reaches, or over 0.5 for a drink named alcohol free
abv.title: Abv

back_after_days.description: For an offer that began on the collection day: the days with no offer right before it, 14 or more, after an earlier offer. Given only when the whole break is on the price record, so it is never a guess
back_after_days.title: Back After Days

buy_quantity.description: How many to buy together to pay you_pay
buy_quantity.title: Buy Quantity

card_needed.description: The loyalty card this price needs: Clubcard, Real Rewards or Lidl Plus. Empty when anyone gets it
card_needed.title: Card Needed

category.description: The shop's department for this product
category.title: Category

cut_today.description: True when the price fell on the collection day on an offer that was running the day before too
cut_today.title: Cut Today

days_on_offer.description: Days on offer without a break from offer_start to the collection day, both included
days_on_offer.title: Days On Offer

id.description: Stable per-retailer product id, e.g. tesco:12345
id.title: Id

kind.description: lowest_ever: under every earlier price on record. first_time: the first offer on record for a product long known at this shop
kind.title: Kind

low_before.description: The lowest price on record before this offer
low_before.title: Low Before

low_before_date.description: The last day it was at low_before, YYYY-MM-DD
low_before_date.title: Low Before Date

lowest_since.description: First day of this product's price record at this shop: the low holds from this day, YYYY-MM-DD
lowest_since.title: Lowest Since

name.description: Product name as the retailer lists it
name.title: Name

offer_ends.description: Last day the offer applies, YYYY-MM-DD, Irish time. Empty when the retailer states no end
offer_ends.title: Offer Ends

offer_share.description: The share of those 90 days it was on any offer, from 0 to 1
offer_share.title: Offer Share

offer_start.description: On offer since: the first day of the unbroken run of days on any offer, shelf or card price, that reaches the collection day, YYYY-MM-DD. The price can have changed during it
offer_start.title: Offer Start

pack.description: Pack size as the retailer lists it
pack.title: Pack

regular_price.description: The product's usual price at this shop, from its own price record: what the saving is measured against, in euro
regular_price.title: Regular Price

run_start.description: The day this price, or a lower one, began, YYYY-MM-DD: the saving is measured against the 90 days before it
run_start.title: Run Start

saving_pct.description: The saving as a percentage of regular_price
saving_pct.title: Saving Pct

similar_offers.description: More products at this shop with the same brand, price and label, not listed separately
similar_offers.title: Similar Offers

started_today.description: True only for an offer that began on the collection day: on offer that day, on none of the three days before, in stock the day before with no offer, and begun that day by the shop's own dates where it states them. A lower price on an offer already running is cut_today, not a new offer
started_today.title: Started Today

store.description: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl
store.title: Store

typical_price.description: The median price over the 90 days before this offer, offer days included, in euro: below regular_price when it was often on offer
typical_price.title: Typical Price

yesterday_price.description: With cut_today, what it cost the day before, in euro, with the same card if one is needed
yesterday_price.title: Yesterday Price

you_pay.description: What one item costs today at this offer, in euro
you_pay.title: You Pay

as_of.description: Latest collection day behind these deals, YYYY-MM-DD
as_of.title: As Of

credits.description: What this answer cost the person's BasketWatch account and what is left. Missing on a free answer

deals.description: Biggest saving first, with the shops mixed unless one was named
deals.title: Deals

hint.description: What to try, when no deal matched
hint.title: Hint

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page; missing on the last
next_offset.title: Next Offset

note.description: What these savings are measured against, and the limits of the data
note.title: Note

offset.description: How many deals this page skipped
offset.title: Offset

total.description: How many deals there are today for this search, all pages
total.title: Total
